name: ADDRESS_MATCH_V1
normalization: require valid finite UTF-8 text within Site address bounds
map CR/LF/TAB and Unicode whitespace to ordinary spaces
trim leading/trailing whitespace and collapse internal whitespace runs to one space
do not remove digits, letters, punctuation or reorder address tokens
candidate_logic: exact address_match_key equality is a strong duplicate candidate, never entity equality
same normalized Site name + equal address key increases review prominence but still never auto-merges
same city/label/name with differing address key is descriptive similarity only
Customer Organization scope is shown but same physical-looking address across Customers remains separate until explicit reviewed decision
creation_rule: CreateSite preview queries indexed address_match_key/name_match_key candidates and shows them before creation. Acceptance may still create a distinct Site; no normalized key is globally unique.
safety: Normalizer is matching-only. Current display retains operator-approved address_text; later correction appends Site history and updates site-derived Dispatch Location display without rewriting historical logistics snapshots.
